title: Spicy Korean Tteok Bowl
description: A flavorful and spicy vegetarian bowl filled with crispy tteok, sweet and spicy sauce, and crunchy vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add grated ginger and minced garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Add tteok and fry until crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
In a separate pan, combine soy sauce, honey, and rice vinegar.
Bring the sauce to a boil and then reduce the heat to simmer.
Add the spicy chili flakes to the sauce and stir well.
To assemble the bowl, place the crispy tteok on a plate, then drizzle the spicy sauce over the top.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
